examples.target: I am doing a master's degree in design, and I really like it.
That sounds demanding. Which subject is your favorite?
My favorite subject is research methods, although the exams are difficult.
Next year, if I meet every deadline and pass my courses.
Full time. I have a scholarship, so I can focus on my studies.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: So, what are you studying at the moment?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I am doing a master's degree in design, and I really like it.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That sounds demanding. Which subject is your favorite?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My favorite subject is research methods, although the exams are difficult.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Next year, if I meet every deadline and pass my courses.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Do you work or study full time?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Full time. I have a scholarship, so I can focus on my studies.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Do you already know what you want to do afterwards?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Not exactly, but I would like to work in a technology company.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That is a good plan. I am sure you will find something.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks! Studying is hard, but I am learning a lot.
